paragraphs.heading: 정체

paragraphs.note: 3 levels, 1/4 meter per 1/3 fill gives 3/4 total; follows from A2.
paragraphs.quote: Each Phlogiston Chiselith has 3 levels of infusion, and most are found with 1-2 levels already filled. It costs 1/4 of the player's Phlogiston Meter to fill 1/3 of a Chiselith.

sentences.t_raw: Phlogiston Meter의 1/4을 소모하면 Chiselith의 1/3을 채울 수 있다.
